runsWhen: The agent encounters an error outside of a tool call.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: The error message. Treat it as untrusted diagnostic content.

inputs.name: errorContext
inputs.description: Where the error happened, so the workflow can branch on the failing stage.

inputs.name: recoverable
inputs.description: Whether the agent believes the operation can be retried. Advisory only.

outputs.name: errorHandling
outputs.description: How to proceed: retry, skip, or abort. Leave empty for default handling.

outputs.name: retryCount
outputs.description: How many times to retry. Only used when errorHandling is retry.

outputs.name: userNotification
outputs.description: A short, user-friendly message shown to the user about the error.

outputs.name: suppressOutput
outputs.description: Set to true to hide this turn's output from the user.
